definitions.explanation: Decisively proceeding with a plan despite obstacles or concerns.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{決行|けっこう}する。

examples.english: Will be held rain or shine.

examples.japanese: {強行|きょうこう}{決行|けっこう}
{反対|はんたい}の{声|こえ}があったにもかかわらず、{社長|しゃちょう}は{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトの{決行|けっこう}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: Despite voices of opposition, the president decided to go ahead with the new project.

notes:
{決行|けっこう} means proceeding resolutely with something.

COMMON USES:
- {雨天|うてん}{決行|けっこう} (rain or shine)
- {計画|けいかく}を{決行|けっこう}する (execute a plan)
- {強行|きょうこう}{決行|けっこう} (force through)

NOTE: Different from 結構 (けっこう - quite, fine, enough).
